evidence.Workflow / Use Case: AI-enabled parcel sorting at China Post logistics sites
evidence.Claim / Evidence Summary: Robotera said more than 100 AI-enabled parcel-sorting robots were deployed across 15 China Post warehouses, providing a concrete scaled commercial logistics use case for humanoid-style robotics.
evidence.Likely Value Capturer: Robotera; China Post; robotics component suppliers
evidence.Constraint / Bottleneck: Commercial reliability; economics; task breadth beyond parcel sorting
evidence.Source Type: Company disclosure via independent news report
evidence.Source Title: China robot makers seek to turn humanoid hype into useful work
evidence.Supporting Excerpt (≤20 words): more than 100 parcel-sorting robots in 15 warehouses nationwide
evidence.Notes: Reuters independently reported the deployment based on a company official and sales representative. The row records operating deployment, not independently measured productivity or labor savings.

evidence.Workflow / Use Case: Humanoid robots packing mobile phones into boxes on an assembly line
evidence.Claim / Evidence Summary: DexForce said its humanoid robots have operated since early 2026 at a Lens Technology factory packing mobile phones, with millimetre-level accuracy and automated error detection and correction.
evidence.Constraint / Bottleneck: Reliability at scale; economics versus labor; deployment breadth
evidence.Source Type: Company disclosure via independent news report
evidence.Source Title: China robot makers seek to turn humanoid hype into useful work
evidence.Supporting Excerpt (≤20 words): robots have been deployed since early this year at a Lens Technology factory
evidence.Notes: Operating factory deployment is source-backed, but no independently measured throughput, cost or headcount impact was disclosed. Labor effect reflects automation of the stated packing task, not a claim of layoffs.

runs.Sources and Queries Checked: Reuters date-targeted Aug. 19 Greater China/East Asia AI, robotics and manufacturing searches; World Robot Conference commercial-deployment coverage; Unitree IPO and robotics adoption coverage; Chery AiMOGA deployment coverage; China digital-sovereignty policy search; due follow-up review
runs.Coverage Gaps / Notes: Two concrete China robotics production deployments met the threshold: Robotera parcel sorting across China Post warehouses and DexForce phone packing at Lens Technology. AiMOGA delivery/police-robot figures were reviewed but not separately logged to avoid over-fragmenting same-day robotics coverage; Unitree market enthusiasm was not treated as representative perception.
